title: ID0418780-DC/Si-D/DE[k6Nk5M] - Enable CCV terminal
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
Activate credit card terminal in SCB for the 3 chargers
Solution:
select Payment Terminal Type = CCV OPM 60
